_about: SOSpesIA mission profiles. Values from the team PROPOSAL (section 1b) and motor_autoridad.py. Items marked ASSUMPTION are team design parameters, not NASA data. Drafted with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).

assumptions.note: Team ASSUMPTIONS: 15 min for a flight surgeon to read and answer; thresholds 0.25 and 1 (flight surgeons would set them before a real mission); 10 % of the link for medical data; live guidance only if the light round trip is <= 3 s.

profiles.name: Low Earth orbit (ISS)
profiles.evacuation: Less than 24 h to definitive care
profiles.evacuation_source: NTRS 20240011063 (PROPOSAL 1b). TO CHECK against the full paper: its abstract does not give this figure

profiles.name: Lunar orbit and transit
profiles.name_es: Órbita lunar y viaje a la Luna
profiles.delay: Seconds (1.3 s one way from distance alone)
profiles.outages: Continuous link with relay (SIMPLIFIED: passes behind the Moon are not modelled)

profiles.name: Lunar south pole, with relay satellite
profiles.name_es: Polo sur lunar, con satélite repetidor
profiles.outages: Continuous link thanks to the relay
profiles.evacuation: Up to about 14 days stabilising on site
profiles.evacuation_source: NTRS 20240011063 (PROPOSAL 1b). TO CHECK against the full paper: its abstract does not give this figure

profiles.name: Lunar south pole, no relay
profiles.outages: Earth is visible only half of each sidereal month (27.32 d): up to 13.66 d without link. SIMULATED calendar
profiles.evacuation: Up to about 14 days stabilising on site
profiles.evacuation_source: NTRS 20240011063 (PROPOSAL 1b). TO CHECK against the full paper: its abstract does not give this figure
profiles.usual_decider: Shared; the crew during link gaps

profiles.name: Mars transit
profiles.delay: 0 to 22 min one way (the Earth-Mars distance of the date is used here: upper bound)
profiles.outages: Weeks without link at solar conjunction (Mars within 2° of the Sun)

profiles.name: Mars surface
profiles.delay: 3 to 22 min one way depending on the date
profiles.outages: Weeks without link at solar conjunction (SIMPLIFIED: relay orbiter passes are not modelled)

profiles.name: Custom mission (any distance)
profiles.delay: Set by the user: any one-way light time
